s.note: Arthur and his mum watching the talk show every night
s.how: Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Melt 100g butter with 200g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup and boil for 4 minutes. Take off the heat, stir in 1/2 tsp bicarb soda and 1 tsp sea salt, then pour over the popcorn and stir to coat. Spread on lined trays and bake at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice. Cool and break up.

Slice 4 Lebanese cucumbers into spears and pack into a jar with dill and sliced garlic. Pour over 250ml white vinegar heated with 250ml water and a spoon each of salt and sugar. Chill overnight. Serve in the jar with rye crispbread alongside.

m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a grated onion, a cup of breadcrumbs, an egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar. Bake at 180C for an hour. Serve thick slices with buttery mash from 1kg potatoes and peas.

w.note: Arthur's life as a party clown
w.how: Wash and dry 6 green apples well, remove the stalks and push in wooden sticks. Heat 400g caster sugar, 125ml water and 1 tbsp white vinegar over medium heat until dissolved, then boil without stirring until it reaches 150C on a thermometer. Add a few drops of red food colouring and swirl. Tilt the pan and dip each apple, twisting to coat, then stand on baking paper to set for 15 minutes.

d.how: Chill 4 coupe glasses in the freezer. Fill a jug with ice and add 240ml bourbon, 80ml sweet vermouth and 4 dashes of bitters. Stir steadily for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the chilled glasses, drop a cocktail cherry into each and twist a strip of orange peel over the top. For a booze-free version, mix cold black tea, cherry juice and a dash of orange.
